caption: The video captures a wide, glassy lake beneath a pale-blue sky streaked with a faint band of low cloud near the right horizon. On the left edge, dry golden reeds rise from a small dark rocky bank, their slender forms mirrored in the still water. Several dark rocks protrude from the foreground surface with soft reflections, while a large out-of-focus rock mass rests at the bottom center. Low hills and a thin line of pale buildings trace the distant shoreline. The framing appears stable, with the reeds, rocks, and horizon holding their positions. Visible movement is largely confined to the water surface, where faint ripple lines drift slowly and reflections shimmer gently near the left bank. No new subject enters the scene, and the lake keeps a placid, glassy character throughout.
relations: Dry reeds on the left bank and foreground rocks persist, casting stable reflections in the still water.
Faint ripples drift slowly across the glassy surface, causing gentle shimmering of reflections near the left bank.
The distant shoreline, low hills, and pale-blue sky remain stable, framing the placid lake without new subjects.
